title: openai/NavierStokesAndEuler
why_read: Formal Lean proofs related to Navier-Stokes and Euler equations are a serious mathematical software engineering contribution, of high interest to anyone in formal verification or fluid dynamics theory.
analysis: This repository provides Lean-formalized 'certificates' supporting results about the Navier-Stokes and Euler equations, which govern fluid dynamics and are tied to one of the Clay Millennium Prize problems around existence and smoothness of solutions. Formalizing such results in a proof assistant like Lean is technically demanding, since it requires encoding deep analysis and PDE theory in a machine-checkable form. Coming from OpenAI, this suggests continued investment in AI-assisted or AI-adjacent formal mathematics, a domain where machine verification meets frontier math research. This is a niche but technically substantial project worth attention from anyone interested in formal methods or mathematical AI.
